creative_brief.topic: market uncertainty and founders navigating volatility
creative_brief.thesis: The image is really about steering through unstable fortune.
creative_brief.abstract_concept: Classical fate confronted with modern volatility charts
creative_brief.visual_metaphor: A classical navigator-figure balancing on a giant astrolabe that doubles as a volatile stock chart, clutching a glowing ledger
creative_brief.image_goal: Business editorial hero with wit, not corporate gloom

art_direction.historical_language: navigator in draped robe, astrolabe, engraved sea-chart waves, stone plinth
art_direction.contemporary_language: candlestick chart arcs, glowing ledger tablet, ticker fragments
art_direction.medium: mixed-media editorial collage, woodcut plus risograph
art_direction.rendering_language: cross-hatched ink with halftone chart lines and stippled waves
art_direction.composition_language: G surreal-scale-shift, giant instrument center with small human balancing
art_direction.color_strategy: warm paper dominant ground, deep ink hero, ultraviolet accent on chart spike
art_direction.texture_strategy: woodcut grain, halftone, paper tooth, ink breakup, distressed edges

visual_spec.hero_subject: robed classical navigator figure balanced atop a giant astrolabe-chart wheel, rendered in deep ink engraving
supporting_elements: candlestick chart arcs forming the astrolabe rings
glowing ledger tablet clutched under arm
engraved waves and small paper boats below
visual_spec.environment: warm paper ground with terracotta wave bands and faint ticker tape strips
visual_spec.composition: Pattern G: giant wheel center at 70% scale, tiny figure on top rim, diagonal chart spike breaking frame top-right, calm negative paper space left
visual_spec.spatial_relationships: foreground waves, midground giant wheel, figure perched on wheel apex
visual_spec.perspective: straight-on poster view with slight tilt, deep focus
visual_spec.lighting: directional graphic light, ink shadow masses under wheel, paper-white highlights on foam
visual_spec.color_hierarchy: warm paper ground, ink hero, ultraviolet chart accent with terracotta support
visual_spec.atmosphere: windy paper-chart atmosphere, crisp graphic motion

non_negotiables: old x new tension (astrolabe x candlestick chart)

prompt_strategy.reason: midjourney: concept seed with discovery room

prompts.primary: Woodcut and risograph editorial collage on warm paper: a robed classical navigator figure in deep black ink engraving balances atop a giant astrolabe wheel whose rings are volatile candlestick chart arcs, clutching a small glowing ledger tablet, engraved sea waves with tiny paper boats churning below and faint ticker tape strips drifting in the sky. Surreal scale shift with the wheel at 70 percent of frame center, figure small on its apex, one ultraviolet chart spike breaking the top-right edge, calm paper negative space left. Warm paper ground with terracotta wave bands and single ultraviolet accent, dense woodcut grain, halftone chart lines, paper tooth and distressed edges, directional graphic light with ink shadow masses and paper-white foam highlights, antique print through modern screen printing, sophisticated provocative slightly absurd business-editorial mood, wordless.
prompts.compact: Engraved navigator balancing on giant astrolabe stock-chart wheel over paper waves, warm paper collage, ink hero, violet accent.
prompts.model_specific: classical navigator balancing on giant astrolabe made of candlestick chart arcs, woodcut risograph editorial collage, warm paper with terracotta waves, ultraviolet accent, surreal scale --ar 16:9 --no glossy CGI, stock photo, text, watermark

negative_prompt.content: generic corporate art, handshake, glossy CGI, stock chart screenshot, bokeh, readable text, watermark
